title: ScSpecTypeUdt
description:
ScSpecTypeUdt is an XDR Struct defined as:

```text struct SCSpecTypeUDT { string name<SC_SPEC_TYPE_NAME_LIMIT>; }; ```

name.description: Byte string, not UTF-8, of at most 1024 bytes, escaped per SEP-51: printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e) is unchanged, except backslash as \\; NUL, tab, LF and CR as \0, \t, \n and \r; any other byte as \xNN. The escaped string may be longer than 1024 characters.
